remarks: Welcome to 2817 Miller Road in Wellsville, a truly exceptional private estate nestled on nearly 8 scenic acres. This spacious 6-bedroom, 7-bathroom home combines timeless craftsmanship, modern upgrades, and resort-style outdoor living in one remarkable property. Step inside from the stunning wraparound flagstone porch into a warm and inviting foyer that immediately showcases the home’s quality and charm. The main level offers generous living spaces including a formal dining room, den/home office, expansive family room with fireplace, and a beautifully designed kitchen featuring a walk-in pantry and excellent flow for entertaining. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite includes dual closets and a private bath, while four additional bedrooms each with their own bath provide comfort and flexibility for family or guests. The finished basement expands the living space with a recreation area, workout room, additional bedroom, and ample storage. Outside, the property transforms into a private retreat. Enjoy summers by the heated in-ground pool with pool house, relax around the secluded firepit area tucked into the woods, or entertain guests from the covered back porch overlooking the beautifully maintained grounds. Additional highlights include hardwood floors, updated windows, newer roof, upgraded electric service, newer septic system, water filtration system, attached garage with custom cabinetry and epoxy flooring, electric charging station. This one-of-a-kind property offers the perfect blend of privacy, comfort, and upscale country living just minutes from the Village of Wellsville. This home comes fully furnished with existing furniture, appliances, outdoor furniture, etc. ALL POTENTIAL BUYERS MUST BE PRE-APPROVED PRIOR TO SHOWINGS.
